title: Prep for AI Configuration
description: Output schema for fabric-ai-meta export prep-for-ai. Captures the manual-application guide for Microsoft Fabric's Prep for AI feature: included tables, excluded columns, AI Instructions text, verified Q&A pairs, and LLM-generated descriptions for objects that lacked them.

included_tables.description: Tables to include in the Fabric Prep for AI Data Schema. Hidden and staging tables are filtered out by the generator.

excluded_columns.description: Map of table name to columns the user should exclude from Prep for AI: hidden columns, sort-by columns, and undocumented keys / foreign keys.

ai_instructions.description: Natural-language AI Instructions text generated for the model. Paste into the Fabric Copilot AI Instructions field.

verified_answers.description: Question-to-DAX mappings derived from time-intelligence measures. Paste each as a Verified Answer in Fabric Copilot.

generated_descriptions.description: LLM-generated descriptions for tables and columns that lacked them. Outer key is table name; inner keys are column names, or the literal '__table__' for the table-level description. Apply via the apply-descriptions CLI command or by manual edit.
